title: King's Proposal Anime Unveils 2027 Debut, Lead Cast, Teaser Visual
content: Aniplex unveiled the lead cast member, the 2027 premiere, and a teaser visual for the anime series of author Koushi Tachibana and illustrator Tsunako 's King's Proposal ( Ōsama no Propose ) light novel series on Sunday. Rie Takahashi will star in the series as Saika Kuozaki, the most powerful mage in the world.
author: ANN

title: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 50 (Finale) Preview, Staff, and Synopsis Revealed
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 has revealed the preview for Episode 10 (Episode 50 overall and anime finale). The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25, before delaying the final two episodes to improve quality .
author: Anime Corner

title: MyGO and Ave Mujica Anime Sequel Reveals January 8, 2027 Release Date
content: The upcoming anime sequel to MyGO and Ave Mujica, titled MyGO and Ave Mujica MyGO and Ave Mujica, revealed a January 8, 2027 release date. A teaser video was also released mainly featuring the cast of Ave Mujica.
author: Anime Corner

title: Date A Live F Last Date Anime Film Key Visual and Trailer Revealed, Gets March 26, 2027 Premiere Date
content: DATE A LIVE F Last Date anime film revealed a new key visual and trailer, along with a March 26, 2027 theatrical release date in Japan. The project was first announced in April without a specified format.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjou, Aruiwa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen' Season 3 in Production
content: The Fantasia Bunko Daikanshasai 2026 event announced a third season for the Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjou, Aruiwa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen ( Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World ) anime series on Sunday, revealing the main staff, cast, and a teaser visual (pictured).

title: Date A Live F Last Date Anime Reveals Film Format, March 26, 2027 Opening in Teaser Video
content: The " Fantasia Bunko Grand Thanksgiving Festival 2026 Online" event on Sunday revealed the anime film format and March 26, 2027 opening date for Date A Live F Last Date , the latest anime project for the Date A Live franchise . The announcement confirms the film is the "concluding arc" for the anime series.
author: ANN

title: 'Akane-banashi 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, Teaser Promo
content: The special livestream presentation for the television anime adaptation of Yuuki Suenaga and Takamasa Moue 's Akane-banashi manga revealed a pair of additional cast, key visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video for the second season on Sunday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Akane-banashi Season 2 Anime Reveals More Cast, Teaser Trailer
